---
name: gametest
description: Create or repair deterministic NeoForge GameTests for world state, blocks, entities, inventories, ticks, persistence, and multiplayer behavior.
---

Use one clear assertion target per test. Control world setup, positions, ticks, random sources, permissions, inventories, dimensions, and cleanup.

Include negative and boundary cases. Add reload, reconnect, and multiplayer coverage when state crosses persistence or networking.

Run the exact GameTest task and full build. Record structure and log evidence for failures.
